description: Expected output format for the KASAN analysis framework

parsed_reports._description: One entry per report file, keyed by report ID (filename without extension)

_entry_schema.bug_type: string: one of [slab-out-of-bounds, slab-use-after-free, use-after-free, null-ptr-deref, global-out-of-bounds, stack-out-of-bounds, wild-memory-access, invalid-free]
_entry_schema.access_type: string or null: 'Read' or 'Write' (null only for invalid-free)
_entry_schema.access_size: int: number of bytes accessed (from 'Read/Write of size N')
_entry_schema.faulting_function: string: function name from BUG line (without +0x... suffix)
_entry_schema.buggy_addr: string: hex address without '0x' prefix (from 'at addr ...')
_entry_schema.tainted: bool: true if kernel is tainted, false if 'Not tainted'
_entry_schema.alloc_stack: list of stack frames (same format) or null if no 'Allocated by' section
_entry_schema.free_stack: list of stack frames (same format) or null if no 'Freed by' section
_entry_schema.slab_cache: string or null: slab cache name (e.g., 'kmalloc-64', 'ext4_extent_status')
_entry_schema.slab_object_size: int or null: slab object size in bytes
_entry_schema.alloc_size: int or null: actual allocation size (from 'allocated/freed N-byte region')
_entry_schema.global_variable: string or null: global variable name (only for global-out-of-bounds)

vm_verdicts._description: One entry per VM test case, keyed by case ID

_entry_schema.verdict: string: one of [pass, trigger, racey, boot_fail]
_entry_schema.pass_count: int: number of VMs that passed (no crash triggered)
_entry_schema.trigger_count: int: number of VMs where bug was triggered
_entry_schema.boot_fail_count: int: number of VMs that failed to boot
_entry_schema.other_count: int: number of VMs with other/unknown outcomes

_entry_schema.pass_rate: float: fraction of bugs with 'pass' verdict
_entry_schema.pass_count: int: number of bugs with 'pass' verdict
_entry_schema.total_bugs: int: total number of bugs evaluated
_entry_schema.unique_solves: list of bug IDs solved ONLY by this config (not by any other)
_entry_schema.avg_cost_per_bug: float: average cost per bug for this config
_entry_schema.compilation_fail_count: int: number of bugs with compilation_fail build status
_entry_schema.bad_patch_count: int: number of bugs with bad_patch build status

experiment_metrics.combined_pass_rate: float: fraction of bugs solved by ANY config (union)
experiment_metrics.combined_pass_count: int: number of bugs solved by at least one config
experiment_metrics.combined_solved_bugs: sorted list of bug IDs solved by any config

rules: 1. If ANY VM has 'boot_fail' outcome -> verdict is 'boot_fail'
3. If all counted outcomes are 'pass' -> verdict is 'pass'
4. If all counted outcomes are 'trigger' -> verdict is 'trigger'
5. If mix of 'pass' and 'trigger' -> verdict is 'racey'
6. If no 'pass' or 'trigger' outcomes and no 'boot_fail' -> verdict is 'other'
